view_frame: Front view uses XZ plane (X width, Z height). Top view uses XY plane (X width, Y depth). Right view uses YZ plane (Y depth, Z height). The object is a solid of revolution generated by rotating the front silhouette around the Z axis.

features.section: Circular cross-sections perpendicular to Z axis
dimensions: Max diameter: 120 mm (ASSUMED based on maximum_dimension_mm)
Height: ASSUMED (proportional to width, approx 1.2x max diameter)
features.placement: Centered at X=0, Y=0. Base at Z=0. Top at Z=Height. The profile is defined by the outer boundary of the front view silhouette.
features.evidence: Single closed silhouette outline in the front view representing the outer profile of a vase.

connections: The vase is a single continuous solid.
edit_rules: Changing the maximum diameter scales the entire profile radially.
Changing the height scales the entire profile vertically.
The profile must remain watertight for 3D printing.
unresolved: Exact height of the vase is not dimensioned; assumed proportional to width.
Exact wall thickness is not specified; assumed solid for structural integrity in 3D printing unless hollowing is requested.
